verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own docs say users can 'use webhooks to asynchronously receive notifications once the transcription job completes,' which is a first-party outbound callback. However, the only evidence is one sentence, and it covers a single event type (async job completion). Missing for 10: details on how webhooks are registered (per-job URL vs account-level), a payload schema, any event types beyond job completion, retry/delivery guarantees, signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
